name: merchant-webapp

dependencies.name: payments-api
dependencies.description: Registers merchants, creates payment requests, reads transactions/balance/payouts, and drives the public checkout a Customer pays through.

dependencies.name: thunder-app
dependencies.description: Signs Merchant users in via SSO.

description: The Merchant-facing single-page app: business registration, dashboard, payment request creation, transaction history, payout account setup and payout requests, refunds, plus the public (unauthenticated) checkout page a Customer opens from a payment link to pay by mobile money or card. Does not process payments itself — it calls payments-api, which talks to the payment gateway.
